reviews.title: Color changes 🤮
reviews.text:
What’s up with the ugly color changes?? It was so much prettier to look at with the pastels. Now the red has become brick red. Seriously? Ugh!

Update: the developers reached out and said they brought back the pastels that were more gentle on the eyes but there have been no changes at all. PLEASE bring back the old colors. These harsh colors are so hard on my eyes. I paid a years subscription for this?? Come on now….

reviews.title: It changes weight units on its own
reviews.text: From time to time it switches from lb to kg on its own

reviews.title: Log weight and nothing else if you don’t want to pay
reviews.text: I think it ridiculous you can’t add notes next to your weight without having to pay. At this point I’ll just keep a journal.

reviews.title: Confusing
reviews.text: The layout and design is confusing, it doesn’t have a goal date, only milestones and it doesn’t clearly show your day to day progress, just some weird graph. It’s confusing tbh. Won’t be continuing on after the trial.

reviews.title: Stopped Working
reviews.text: I loved this app, it was great… then it just stopped syncing with my other apps. So even though my other apps had recorded my weight and this app had been syncing for months, now it’s just not doing that. I went in and searched for fixes. I reset the sync settings a few times and that worked for a day or two and pretty soon it just stopped again. Incredibly frustrating, I found this very helpful when it had the data that all my other health apps have. I’m not manually entering my weight everyday and I’m not troubleshooting the sync settings every day either. So I’m deleting this app and hope I’ll find something similar one day that actually works.

reviews.title: So disappointed
reviews.text: Now you have to pay for a subscription to see anything. Mind you I’ve been using this for almost 2 years while losing 125 pounds. Now I can’t see any of my history without paying. This is so ridiculous. Do better!!
